notes.title: v1.63
notes.content:
Minor update, a clever ergonomic modification and various bugfixes !

[h1]Ergonomy[/h1]
[list]
[*]Planet opacity changes once the player has used all the associated actions.
[/list]

[h1]Bugfix[/h1]
[list]
[*]Missile ammo now decreases after destroying an asteroid field.
[*]System failure repair now repairs 4 items again on habitable planets (instead of 2)
[*]Unprovoked neutral NPC no longer attacks the player when the player attacks an enemy.
[*]Neutral NPC shoots back again after the player uses multi-target on him
[*]Multitarget no longer works when the player doesn't have enough ammo
[*]It's no longer possible to use a higher level attack than the ammo level allows
[*]Turn count no longer glitches when neutral NPCs are EMP paralysed
[*]Missile gauge corrected to take into account only valid targets during multitargeting.
[*]Corrected instances where it wasn't possible to use the missile launcher when only one missile was left.
[*]Corrected instances where it wasn't possible to use the laser when only one thorium unit was left.
[/list]

notes.title: v1.38 is LIVE !
notes.content:
This is the 2nd and major update to the EOPN - Test RS video game \o/ ːsteamhappyː The game is building up new features and will continue to do so to become the ultimate training tool, a 3D space chess wrapped in a good story (it's coming).

[h1]Features at a glance[/h1]
What players will find now is :
[list]
[*]Savegames (automatic after each turn and 2 manual slots), so that your progression is never lost
[*]Progression (new rank every 10 reputation points) [ship upgrades coming SOON]
[*]Blackhole gameplay to ambush enemies
[*]A timer in critical actions to put pressure on your decisions
[*]Asteroid destruction that impacts other NPCs
[*]Multi-action in zoomed mode so you don't have to zoom in and out of the same position for several possible actions
[*]VFX for the game (attacks lvl1 and 2. More animations coming)
[*]New animations
[*]Refined game balance (see changelog) and UI ergonomy (right clicking cycles through the CODEX pages)
[/list]
More features and details in the changelog below, with my thanks to the players and my gratitude to Nicolas Martinez (dev), Vadim Sadovski (cutscenes, some great ones coming) and Yuri Podchasha (VFX, more sexiness coming too).

Peace out
Américo "cockpitseeker"

[h1]Changelog[/h1]

[h2]New features[/h2]
[list][*]Added a timer during fights, if the player does not take action in the allotted time, the player loses his turn.
[*]End of integration of menus and display of saves
[*]Addition of the backup system in JSON format
[*]Add automatic save at the end of each turn of the game.
[*]In zoomed view, clicking in space or on the player's ship allows you to access a choice to exit the zoomed view without performing any action
[*]Blackholes:
[list][*]During a blackhole move, all enemies within 3 squares are attracted.
[*]For a period of 15 seconds, the player loses autonomy and must click with the left mouse click to resist the attraction of the blackhole.
[*]In case of defeat if sucked by the blackhole, the game ends.
[*]In case of victory, player returns to the map with all attracted enemies destroyed.
[/list]
[*]Asteroids [ticket 004]:
[list]
[*]The action "destroy an asteroid" is now a zoomed view action.
[*]Destroying an asteroid now causes 1 point of damage to the ships present on the same spot (allies/neutrals/enemies)
[*]The enemy/neutral ships destroyed by this action give the usual reputation and loot bonuses/malus
[*]The ally ships destroyed give a malus of 3 reputation points and no loot.
[/list]
[*]During a jump on the player's current position, enemies now move randomly around the player. [Ticket 008] Enemy ship randomly moves from 1 to 3 squares (depending on the level of the enemy ship) around him.
[*]Added visual effects when the player attacks in combat phase [ticket 006]
[/list]

[h2]Balance[/h2]
[list][*]When a resource module is destroyed, the associated resources are lost.
[*]During the smuggling action with an enemy, if no resources are exchanged, the fight resumes.
[*]The action "Wait for help" when the autonomy module is destroyed, repairs the module at the cost of a BTC or a reputation point.
[*]Change of the score formula to (reputation / laps)
[*]It is now possible in a single turn to perform several actions in zoomed view.
[*]Combat timer goes from 20 sec to 12 sec
[*]Smuggling with an enemy no longer stops the timer. At the end of the timer, the exchange in progress is validated as it is.
[*]Timer changes to 15 sec (to stay true to the exam)
[*]"Wait for help" triggers repair and cost values proportional to the level of called allied ship
[*]Addition of reputation equal to the cumulative amount of enemy levels destroyed during a blackhole interaction [ticket 003]
[*]Change of the action "Give a ransom" [Ticket 007]
[list]
[*]The cost of the action becomes 1 BTC per enemy level
[*]The reward of the action becomes to 1 reputation point per enemy level[/list]
[/list]

[h2]Ergonomy[/h2]
[list]
[*]New reticle in topography view
[*]The smuggling action with an enemy ship allows you to go back to the non combat to atmosphere (no red light).
[*]Added allied ship animation for clarity during the "wait for help" action

notes.title: Update notes for September 15th, 2024
notes.content:
First update here we go!! ːsteamhappyː
Game jumps from v1.20 to v1.24 today.

[h2]Bug squashing[/h2]
[list]
[*]Issue: With damaged (1 to 3) systems, repairing on habitable planets, hovering over the "repair" button, the game would freeze.
Cause : Infinite loop executing on the damaged systems blue notification effect.
Solution : Loop closed, no execution till infinity ^^'.
[*]Issue : With arsenal lvl3, it's possible to pay ransom without money.
Cause : Code error in resource verification for action.
Solution : Condition correction for action validation.
[*]Spying 1 to 3 jumps away, arriving with 0 invisibility, spying doesn't consume the other actions possible on that spot, which the player can still perform if the conditions are met.
[*]Sound FX made to overlap instead of the new one playing cutting the previous.
[*]Master warning/master caution blinking again with the new random failure system (see below)
